the BFOA-optimization-based FPI/FPD controller outperforms other controllers in terms of dynamic performance indices and robustness.

BFOA-optimization of fuzzy PI/PID controllers is able to provide improved performance over PSO, FA, BFOA, PS, PSO, GA and hybrid FA-PS tuned PI controllers for the AGC of multi-source multi-area traditional/restricted electrical power systems.

BFOA- and PSO-based fuzzy PI/PID controllers have been designed for AGC of traditional and restructured electrical power systems and are able to handle wide range of loading conditions and system parameters variations with improved performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a FPI/FPD controller for the automatic generation control of traditional/restructured electrical systems.
the application of BFOA to design a FPI/FPD controller to improve the transient stability of interconnected power systems.

a new approach for the design of a BFOA-optimised FPI/FPD controller for the AGC of traditional/restructured power systems, which can be used as a benchmark to design a similar controller for any other system structure.

the proposed FPI/FPD controller is able to handle the uncertainties in the system parameters and load variations, and hence, can be used for automatic generation control in the real power system.
BFOA-based FPI/FPIDs are able to handle AGC of multi-source multi-area power systems in traditional and restructured scenarios with improved dynamic response and robustness.

the proposed FPI/FPIDs are capable of handling the AGC of the power systems with excellent performance in terms of settling time and steady-state error, and are also robust to the variations in system parameters.

BFOA is able to optimize the gains of fuzzy controllers in an effective manner, which is evident from the results presented in the paper.
BFOA is a simple yet effective optimization algorithm, which can be employed for automatic generation control (AGC) of power systems.
FPI/FPAD controller is a promising candidate for AGC of interconnected power systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the FPI/FPD controller optimized using BFOA can be used for automatic generation control in multi-area power systems with excellent results.

the proposed BFOA-optimization technique is capable of providing superior performance in terms of settling time, peak overshoot and undershoot and integral absolute error in comparison with other state-of-the-art algorithms for the systems under consideration.
